items.definition:
a person who is learning
She is a fast learner.

an animal's foot
The dog lifted its paw to shake hands.

a small, common bird
A little sparrow landed on the window sill.

a leafy green vegetable
Popeye loves to eat spinach for strength.

a dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid in a closed dish or pan
My grandmother makes a delicious beef stew.

a castrated bull, used as a draft animal
The farmer used an ox to pull the plow.

a portable battery-operated electric lamp
I used a flashlight to find my way in the dark.

a metric unit of volume equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters
The bottle contains one liter of water.

a marine mollusk with eight arms
An octopus can change its color to blend in with its surroundings.

each of the segments of the corolla of a flower, which are typically colored
The rose had soft, velvety petals.

a light shoe consisting of a sole held to the foot by straps
She wore sandals to the beach.

a green fruit with a large pit
I like to add avocado to my salad for a creamy texture.

a large tub for bathing
The children love to play with their toys in the bathtub.

a thin, crisp biscuit
I like to eat cheese and crackers as a snack.

a person whose job is to entertain others
The cruise ship hired a new entertainer for the evening shows.

the introductory page of a website
I set my favorite news site as my browser's homepage.

the activity of making fabric by interlocking loops of yarn
She enjoys knitting in the evenings.

a thick, smooth liquid preparation for the skin
She applied sunscreen lotion before going to the beach.

a restaurant in which customers serve themselves from a counter and pay before eating
We usually eat lunch in the school cafeteria.

a person with whom one works
My coworker helped me finish the project on time.

a paved outdoor area adjoining a house
We had dinner on the patio last night.

A card for sending messages by post without an envelope
She sent me a beautiful postcard from Paris.

a schedule of times
Check the train timetable for departure times.

a small cart with wheels
She pushed the shopping trolley down the aisle.

a continuous dull pain
She had a dull ache in her back.

an electric machine used for mixing soft food or liquids
She used the blender to make a smoothie.

a form of entertainment in which amateur singers sing along to recorded music
We went to a karaoke bar last night and sang our favorite songs.

stomach (informal)
My tummy hurts after eating too much.

a shop where books are sold
I love spending hours browsing in a quiet bookstore.

a long-handled brush used for sweeping
She used a broom to sweep the dust off the floor.

a house on a farm
They decided to buy an old farmhouse in the countryside.

a small bag carried by women
She put her keys and phone into her handbag.

a long, green-skinned fruit, eaten as a vegetable
She added slices of cucumber to her salad.

a small cake baked in a cup-shaped foil or paper container
The children decorated their cupcakes with sprinkles.

a person who helps someone else
My little brother was a great helper in the kitchen.

a strip of hair growing above the upper lip
He decided to grow a mustache for Movember.

a device that projects an image onto a screen
The teacher used a projector to display the presentation slides.

an area of ice or a floor for skating
We went ice skating at the local rink.

a person who robs
The police caught the robber after a chase.

water closet; toilet
Could you tell me where the WC is?

the front window of a car
The rain was so heavy I could barely see through the windshield.

sheets, blankets, and other coverings for a bed
She changed the bedding on the bed every week.

an electrical device that makes a buzzing sound
Press the buzzer to open the door.

a succulent plant with a thick, fleshy stem and typically no leaves, usually bearing spines
The desert is home to many types of cactus.

a hooded sweatshirt
She put on her favorite hoodie because it was cold.

a cereal plant cultivated for its edible grain
Oats are a healthy breakfast choice.

a substance, typically a liquid, applied to hair after shampooing to improve its condition
She applied conditioner to her hair after washing it.

an implement for cleaning floors
Please use the mop to clean up the spill.

a public toilet
Excuse me, where is the nearest restroom?

a woman's loose upper garment resembling a shirt
She wore a white silk blouse with a black skirt.

the larva of a butterfly or moth, having a segmented body with many legs
A tiny caterpillar was slowly crawling on the leaf.

a secondary school for students typically between the ages of 14 and 18
She graduated from high school last year.

a tool with a long handle and a row of teeth at the head, used for gathering leaves or smoothing soil
He used a rake to clear the leaves from the lawn.

the middle of the day; noon
We usually have lunch around midday.

a type of porridge made from oats
I like to eat oatmeal for breakfast.

a soft, comfortable shoe for wearing indoors
She put on her warm slippers after a long day.

a paste used for cleaning teeth
Don't forget to put the cap back on the toothpaste.

a protective garment
She put on her apron before baking the cake.

a small plant with three-lobed leaves
The field was full of green clover.

a book of recipes
She found a new recipe in her favorite cookbook.

A piece of furniture with drawers for clothes.
She put her folded clothes in the dresser.

An act of clasping a person's hand, used as a greeting or to show agreement.
They sealed the deal with a firm handshake.

A person who installs and repairs pipes and fittings for water, gas, or sanitation
We called a plumber to fix the leaky faucet.

a thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event
I bought a souvenir T-shirt from Paris.
